page.title: Donate 1 % of your income.
page.description: Give 1 % of your income, monthly or once. {percent} % of every contribution reaches people living in extreme poverty directly.
page.impact-monthly: {directCount, plural, one {# person gets} other {# people get}} an income, {indirectCount} more benefit

faq.why-one-percent-a: 1 % is an amount most people hardly notice in their own budget, but it makes a big difference for someone living in extreme poverty. You can also choose any other amount.
faq.cancel-q: Can I stop my monthly donation?
faq.cancel-a: Yes, at any time and without giving a reason. You manage your donation in your account.
faq.tax-q: Can I deduct my donation from my taxes?
faq.tax-a: Social Income is an association with tax exemption in the canton of Zurich. You find your donation certificate in your account. Please check your local tax rules for details.

path.intro: From you straight onto the recipients’ phones, every month. In five steps.
path.donate-text: Monthly or once, with the payment method you prefer. You can change or stop a monthly donation at any time.
path.forward-text: Social Income is a tax-exempt association in Zurich and forwards your donation every month.
path.phone-text: Recipients get their income through mobile money. They don't need a bank account.
path.decide-text: People spend the money on what they need most: food, school fees, health care, rent or savings.
path.survey-text: In regular surveys, recipients tell us what has changed in their lives. We publish the results.
path.survey-proof: {percent} feel happier thanks to Social Income
